items.title: E3 F-dominance causal replay, COMMITTED REGIME (H1-H4 re-test; fixes 925 commit-gate deadlock)
items.note: SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-925 (same question H1-H4; corrected instrument). WHY: V3-EXQ-925 reported committed_fraction=0.000 and concluded a SELECTOR REGIME finding (that the substrate does not occupy a committed regime at default config). Verified by direct runtime measurement at authoring (2026-08-25) that this was a DRIVER DEFECT, not a substrate fact: `committed` is set at e3_selector.py:3451 as `_running_variance < commit_threshold`; `_running_variance` is written only by update_running_variance, whose in-substrate call site is post_action_update (:3979, reached from REEAgent.update_residue at agent.py:9972). 925's driver calls neither, so _running_variance stayed pinned at precision_init=0.5 against commit_threshold=0.4 and commitment was arithmetically impossible before the run started. Measured: rv pinned at exactly 0.500000 across a 260-tick probe; adding the single missing call gives rv 0.500000 -> 0.007956 and committed_fraction 0.000 -> 0.959 over 8 episodes at UNCHANGED default config. e3_selector.py:3969-3973 documents this exact deadlock and fixes it inside post_action_update; 97 other drivers call it, 925 does not. SEPARATELY: the lever failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-925_2026-08-12 recommended (use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature) could NOT have engaged commitment -- both call sites (e3_selector.py:3683,:3763) are inside `elif committed:`, so it was a dead branch, bit-identical to OFF. It is retained here as ARM_COMMIT_GSCT where it becomes reachable for the first time (MECH-439 Factor B). GOVERNANCE CONSEQUENCE: the H0 'SELECTOR REGIME' discovery leg registered from 925 and the MECH-439 evidence_quality_note drafted for /governance Step 2b review both rest on the incorrect reading and should be re-weighed against this run; neither has been applied to claims.yaml yet. ARMS (2 x 3 seeds): ARM_COMMIT = deadlock fix alone at stock commit config (commitment_threshold unchanged at 0.4) so commitment engages as an emergent learned property, not a config artefact; ARM_COMMIT_GSCT adds use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature=True. C0-C5 counterfactual replay arithmetic, env, agent config and SD-056 P0 recipe are verbatim 925 so the comparison is clean. DV-SYMMETRY (per arm, CLAUDE.md): ARM_COMMIT's manipulation mutates _running_variance, the scalar the DV thresholds, and gates WHICH selection branch executes -- not a broadcast constant, monotone rescaling, or permutation; empirically not invariant (DV moves 0.000 -> 0.959). ARM_COMMIT_GSCT changes the selection RULE (argmin -> gap-scaled multinomial over the same scores), so rank DVs are not protected from it; its one degenerate mode (all-decisive gap_norm collapsing T_eff onto base, making the arm silently equal ARM_COMMIT) is MEASURED as the gsct_teff_spread precondition rather than assumed -- smoke measured 0.130 against a 1e-6 floor. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is the committed-conditioned C0-C5 deltas (delta_p_safer / total_variation / argmin_flip over committed events). Checked v3_exq_925_..._20260812T090142Z_v3 (the only run in this lineage): it records n_committed_events=0, so the readout is structurally absent, not merely unrecorded -- NOT recoverable, must run. That manifest also records NEITHER commit_gate_variance NOR effective_threshold, so the commit margin cannot be sized from banked data; this run records both per event, closing that recording debt. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: N/A, claim_ids=[] (nothing to count). Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate: 2 open 'corrupting' entries share a module with this driver but neither path is reachable here -- 'mode-governance-engagement' needs the cingulate salience coordinator (verified agent.salience_coordinator is None, use_salience_coordinator=False) and 'MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION' is scoped to run_sws_schema_pass (verified all sleep flags False, sleep_loop_manager None). KNOWN LIMITATION (open 'degrading' entry SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION, ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py): the score_trajectory() fallback path carries untrained scorer subnetworks (reality_scorer, harm_cost_fallback_scorer) -- this run executes under that known limitation. DEVIATION from the CLAUDE.md seed-44-on-reef-config guidance: SEEDS kept at [42,43,44] rather than substituting 45, because seed comparability with the superseded 925 is load-bearing here and the flagged instability did not manifest in this config -- seed 44 was 925's BEST seed (cand_world_pairwise_dist 0.1568, 1307 events, cleared both floors) and was clean across both smoke runs. NOTE ON REGIME COVERAGE: 925's dataset is entirely uncommitted and 925a's is expected near-entirely committed (smoke: committed_fraction=1.000 in all 6 cells), so the two runs together give both regimes; 925a alone cannot contrast them within-run. Smoke: PASS (6/6 cells, both arms gate-green, substrate_hash hoisted from per-cell fingerprints, dry manifest correctly relocated out of evidence/).
